title: Author the production design-power pack descriptor (Phase F-2)
description: Author the production design-power descriptor (JSON, conforming to state/pack-descriptor.schema.json) as pack DATA. This is uat-only (design/product data has no falsifiable gate per addon-packs.md §7) BUT carries a cheap tests-after validation lock (see ACs). Top-level fields (all derivable): id=design-power, name=Diseno Poderoso, version=0.1.0, core_compat=\">=1.0.0\" (must satisfy HOOK_API_VERSION=1.0.0), trigger={intake_question, activates_when: design_heavy==yes}, project_md_contribution=[perfil_proyecto, tier] (MUST exactly equal deriveProfileFields return keys), gate_scopes=[design_pipeline], pipeline = the 9 steps matching pipelineSteps keys in src/design-profile.js. resources[] with each activate_when mirroring resourceActivations predicates (src/design-profile.js §5.2). RESEARCHED PINS (use verbatim for the acted-upon resources): ui-ux-pro-max (kind:skill, origin github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill, pin sha 12b486b22e67f5d887962ef8351c1ac863bfaeb9, required:soft, activate_when tier!==LIGERO, assimilate-path), shadcn/ui (kind:mcp, pin 4.13.0, activate_when framework==react && ui_outside_canvas), shadcn-vue (kind:mcp, pin 2.7.4, activate_when framework==vue && ui_outside_canvas), firecrawl (kind:mcp, pin 3.22.3, activate_when needs_research), playwright (kind:mcp, pin 0.0.77, activate_when tier==COMPLETO && ui_outside_canvas). ORCHESTRATOR PRODUCT DECISIONS (apply exactly): DROP gsap (kind enum is skill|mcp|plugin; gsap is a plain npm lib -> not a Claude resource; add via the implementation pipeline step as a project dep, not the descriptor). OMIT openart (no trustworthy pin exists; schema requires pin minLength 1 -> do NOT fabricate; document openart as manual OAuth connect in a descriptor comment/notes or the pipeline docs). KEEP frontend-design (kind:plugin, required:hard, activate_when always/design_heavy) but mark its pin honestly — plugins are TUI-install-only / Wave-2 (not acted on by the reconciler), so use the official plugin marketplace origin and a pin the human will ratify; flag it in the UAT. Grounds: investigator Phase F memo §1/§2/§5 FP-2.
acceptance_criteria: validatePackDescriptor(descriptor) returns { valid: true } (a tests-after lock asserts this) and additionalProperties/required checks pass against state/pack-descriptor.schema.json.

Every resource's activate_when references a predicate whose resource id is a key of resourceActivations(...) in src/design-profile.js (a tests-after lock cross-checks the id set); project_md_contribution === deriveProfileFields return keys ([perfil_proyecto, tier]); pipeline === the pipelineSteps keys.

The acted-upon resources carry the researched pins verbatim (ui-ux-pro-max sha 12b486b..., shadcn/ui 4.13.0, shadcn-vue 2.7.4, firecrawl 3.22.3, playwright 0.0.77); gsap is ABSENT from resources[]; openart is ABSENT from resources[] (documented as manual connect); frontend-design is present with an honestly-marked Wave-2 pin.

UAT (delegated to Orchestrator): the descriptor loads + validates, the activation predicates align with src/design-profile.js, and the three product decisions (drop gsap, omit openart, frontend-design pin flagged) are recorded in the uat comment for human ratification.
